business_problem: Faced with complexities and high operational costs after rapid growth, the organization needed to consolidate a fragmented data landscape.
solution_summary: Parexel modernized its analytics estate on Power BI, Power Platform, Power Apps, moving from fragmented legacy tooling to a governed cloud data platform. Operational, enterprise, or sensor data is ingested into a shared cloud store and transformed with Azure engineering services so teams can work from one current source of truth. Power BI then serves dashboards, self-service exploration, and decision support to business users at scale. It achieved an 85% reduction in data engineering tooling costs, a 30% increase in staff efficiency, and a 70% reduction in time to market for data product delivery.

solution_components.name: Power BI
solution_components.role: Delivers dashboards, reports, and self-service analytics to business users.

solution_components.name: Power Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the low-code automation and application platform for workflow modernization.

solution_components.name: Power Apps
solution_components.role: Delivers custom business applications and front-end workflows to employees.

solution_components.name: Azure Databricks
solution_components.role: Transforms large-scale data and runs analytical or machine-learning workloads.

solution_components.name: Azure Data Lake Storage
solution_components.role: Stores raw and curated data for analytics, AI, and downstream reporting.

data_flow: Data flows from operational systems through source-system connectors into Azure Data Lake Storage, where Azure Databricks prepares and enriches it; Power BI then exposes governed analytics and decision support to end users.
business_outcome: It achieved an 85% reduction in data engineering tooling costs, a 30% increase in staff efficiency, and a 70% reduction in time to market for data product delivery.
